movers.text: Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, team-high 3.8 apg) fractured his left wrist vs. Georgia and had surgery; UNC says he is out about two months (announced 11/17).
Point guard Landen Joseph (26.5 mpg) limped off with an ankle injury late in the 63-46 win over Utah on 11/20 and left on crutches; no update yet. Tristian Ford ran the point after.
Starter Jordan Scott (23 mpg, shoulder) is questionable vs. Detroit Mercy (noon ET); he seemed to re-aggravate it at Tennessee and Tom Izzo said the call is up to the doctors.
Starter Coen Carr (22 mpg, right knee tendinitis) is questionable vs. Detroit Mercy; Kaleb Glenn and Cam Ward would see more minutes if he and Scott sit.
